title: Sunny Bunny Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Sunny Bunny is a lovely beach home with designer furnishings and touches throughout! Prime Seaside, Florida location only 367 feet to the beach access on Robert's Way. Amazing furnished porch!
description_expanded: Description78 ROBERT'S WAY2 QUEENS, 2 DAYBEDSWelcome to Sunny Bunny | A Seaside Beach Bungalow Across from the GulfWelcome to Sunny Bunny, a coastal-chic beach bungalow in the heart of Seaside, Florida, ideally located at the corner of Robert’s Way and Scenic Highway 30A—directly across from the beach. New to our rental program, this airy, designer-decorated cottage promises a refreshing and relaxing Seaside getaway with unbeatable proximity to the Gulf and town amenities.Coastal Design & Open-Concept LivingUpon arrival, enjoy the ease of private driveway parking before stepping into a bright, open-concept first floor with high ceilings and abundant natural light. The living space is thoughtfully curated with crisp white slipcovered seating, luxury hardware, and a large flat-screen TV—perfect for movie nights, board games, or unwinding after a beach day. Soft coastal tones and designer finishes create a space that feels both elevated and inviting.The fully renovated kitchen is a standout, featuring quartz stone countertops, a farmhouse sink, custom built-in cabinetry, a four-burner gas range, and a generously sized refrigerator—ideal for preparing family meals or casual coastal entertaining. Adjacent to the kitchen, the dining area comfortably seats six with a mix of bench seating and chairs.Comfortable Bedrooms & Thoughtful LayoutThe first-floor bedroom offers a queen bed plus a daybed sofa that sleeps an additional guest, along with a mounted flat-screen TV, storage, and privacy doors. This room is conveniently located near a beautifully renovated shared full bathroom with a tub/shower combination.Upstairs, a cozy open loft overlooks the main living area and features a twin daybed, providing a private sleeping nook for additional guests. The second-floor primary suite is a serene retreat with a queen bed, dresser, mounted flat-screen TV, and a renovated ensuite bathroom with a single vanity and a large glass-enclosed walk-in shower with a rain showerhead. A sliding barn door maximizes space and storage, while the private balcony—with seating for two and a slight Gulf view—offers the perfect perch for sunset watching over the treetops and town.Outdoor Living in True Seaside StyleJust off the rear porch, discover a tranquil open-air outdoor retreat complete with comfortable lounge seating and a bistro dining table for four. This shaded space is ideal for al fresco meals, morning coffee, or quiet afternoons with a book, overlooking peaceful paths and yard space.Your Seaside Escape AwaitsWith its across-the-street beach location, stylish interiors, multiple outdoor living areas, and prime placement along Scenic 30A, Sunny Bunny offers the perfect blend of comfort, charm, and Seaside simplicity. Whether you’re planning a family beach vacation or a laid-back coastal reset, this one-of-a-kind Seaside cottage is ready to welcome you.*This home has ring cameras at the front and rear of the home, no cameras inside the home.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURES1,134 Square Feet of thoughtfully designed coastal living spacePrivate Seaside Residential Beach Access at Tupelo Pavilion2-Minute Walk (367 feet) to Beach Access and a 5-Minute Walk to Seaside Amphitheater & Central SquarePeacock Alley Premium Linens – Fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeResort-Style Amenities Access including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome Tote Included with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized Guest Service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking Information – 2 parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes; a golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo Pets AllowedSTR24-000477
